COUNTY BOUNDARY
ARIZONA
Apache County
Population64,400 (2025 est.)
County SeatSt. Johns
Land Area11,198 sq mi
Density6 / sq mi
Median Household Income$41,400
Median Home Value$63,700
Apache County occupies Arizona's northeast corner and is dominated by tribal trust land — principally the Navajo Nation, with Fort Apache reservation land in the south — which places the large majority of its acreage outside the conventional fee-simple market. Roughly 64,400 residents spread across 11,198 square miles, a density near six people per square mile, with St. Johns as the county seat. Median household income of $41,400 and median home value of $63,700 are among the lowest in the state. Transactable private inventory concentrates in the non-reservation southern communities: St. Johns, Springerville, Eagar and the Concho area.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: September 12, 2026
